content:
Hi, Linda. What are you doing?
I am fingerpainting, Laura.
That looks like fun. Can I try?
Sure, you can. Sit down here.
What do I do?
First, you have to get a piece of paper.
Okay. I got it.
Use my colors to draw. It's fun.
